Hector (sec): LogScannerBot flagged something in staging logs: gs://staging-archive/backup-2026-04-15.log contains envelope metadata and tiny base64 fragments.
LogScannerBot: match: /envelope:\{.*wrapped_key.*\}/ found 1 object; sample line: `... envelope:{wrapped_key: "projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-live-2025", iv:"eJyrV1Q9AAECAwQ="} ...`
Lina (infra): that's a wrapped_key identifier plus IV. not raw key material but still reduces scope. marking as sensitive.
Vijay (dev): where did that come from? backup-agent? webhook consumer?
Hector (sec): initial grep shows two candidates: backup-agent and partner-ingest-worker both have debug serialization of envelope data.
Vijay (dev): quick repo grep:
```
$ git grep -n "envelope" services || true
services/backup-agent/logging.go:67: log.Debugf("envelope=%+v", envelope)
services/partner-ingest/main.go:143: log.Debugf("transit envelope: %s", envelopeJson)
```
Lina (infra): I'm suspending backup-agent push and setting bucket to private-read for group backup-ops only. running: `gsutil iam ch group:backup-ops@redwood-inference:objectViewer gs://staging-archive`
Emma (compliance): hold external notifications. we'll confirm if any partner rows are present before outreach.
Hector (sec): immediate containment checklist: 1) list & snapshot affected objects, 2) revoke service account tokens used by agents, 3) rotate KMS wrap key(s) referenced, 4) purge matched objects (preserve audit), 5) full pattern scan across last 180 days.
Lina (infra): snapshotting list now and creating INFSEC-700 ticket for rotation + postmortem.
Vijay (dev): patch ready to remove envelope debug logs and add redaction. will push to staging after RBAC change.
LogScannerBot: automated scan progress: scanning 180 days... matches found: 6 objects.
Hector (sec): proposed KMS plan: create new key `wrap-live-2026-04` then update agent configs to use it and rewrap blobs where needed. mark old key for scheduled destroy after 72h if no active unwraps.
Lina (infra): creating new key now: `gcloud kms keys create wrap-live-2026-04 --location=global --keyring=backups --purpose=encryption`
Lina (infra): created key id k-wrap-202604-01.
Vijay (dev): rewrap helper script queued. we'll prefer re-encrypt by re-running backups where possible to avoid double-wrap complexity.
Emma (compliance): ensure audit export is attached to INFSEC-700, include access logs and object versions. GCS has versioning on; I'll open support ticket for expedited version deletion (ticket GCS-9812).
Hector (sec): add CI gate: helm values must not set DEBUG=true for staging/prod clusters. we'll add a lint that fails deploys if DEBUG present outside dev.
Lina (infra): RBAC change done: removed domain:devs@redwood-inference from bucket viewer; added group:backup-ops only.
LogScannerBot: scan complete: 6 objects, all internal staging. no partner PII seen in quick sample.
Hector (sec): good. owners: Lina -> purge & IAM + GCS ticket, Vijay -> code patch + deploy, Hector -> KMS rotation plan + rewrap, Emma -> compliance/audit thread and legal hold if needed.
Vijay (dev): pushed patch to drop envelope logging and added redaction util. will deploy after infra rollback window.
Emma (compliance): legal hold: pending until final sample review. will update INFSEC-700.
Hector (sec): summary: discovery = envelope metadata in logs caused by debug logging; containment = RBAC tightened, objects purged, service creds rotated; mitigation = KMS wrap key rotation and CI lint to block DEBUG in non-dev.
Lina (infra): finishing purge of current versions; opened GCS support ticket GCS-9812 for version purge escalation.
Vijay (dev): redeploying patched partner-ingest and backup-agent with LOG_LEVEL=info.
Hector (sec): thanks all. please document timeline & links in INFSEC-700; we'll run a short postmortem next week. :lock:
